cost_base: RTO + East plus admin, no invoice overhead; same accounting as cost-risk milestone
future_actual_error: diagnostic/label only, never a same-delivery trading feature
sample_status: retrospective chronological evaluation on previously inspected years, no untouched holdout
publication_status: evaluated_at is creation time, not independently archived public release; 15-minute buffer is an assumption
wind_solar_status: API history retained 30 days only; not included in 2022-2025 backtest
protocol_note: Before first strategy fit, use 10:00 EPT (before 11:00 DA close) to admit 09:45-created forecast after 15-minute buffer. This change was based on feed timestamp coverage, not backtest performance.
